subject: Partner credit issuance for CloudCorp marketplace onboarding
messages:
From: Patrick O'Neill <patrick.oneill@cloudcorp.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudcorp.com
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood credits for CloudCorp trial credit program

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the fast responses during the listing review. Our partner success team asked if Redwood can issue a set of Marketplace-issued credits to new signups that activate via the CloudCorp listing. They want a pool of 100 x $250 promo credits for US customers for the pilot month.

Quick questions:
- Is Redwood comfortable with partner-issued credits that are distributed by CloudCorp and redeemable on the hosted API?
- Is there any extra compliance or billing tracking we need to enable on our side?

I've attached the rough voucher list (partner_voucher_list.csv) with placeholder codes and the CloudCorp program terms.

Would appreciate a short runbook we can use so our Marketplace-ops team can finish onboarding.

Cheers,
Patrick
Partner Programs | CloudCorp
patrick.oneill@cloudcorp.com

Attachment: partner_voucher_list.csv (CSV, 100 rows - voucher_code, expiry_date, amount)
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Patrick O'Neill <patrick.oneill@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for CloudCorp trial credit program

Hi Patrick —

Thanks — this is totally doable. Short answers up front: yes for partner-distributed credits, and we have a lightweight tracking flow we prefer for marketplace vouchers to avoid accounting confusion. I'll summarize below and loop Rafael for final approvals.

What we need from CloudCorp (minimal):
- A list of voucher codes and the dollar value per code (CSV) — good, received.
- Exact redemption URL (marketplace listing link) and any customer-facing text.
- Geographic scope — you indicated US-only, please confirm.

What Redwood will do / requirements:
- Accept voucher redemptions on the hosted API only (we can't apply vouchers to Dedicated/Private invoices).
- Each voucher will be mapped to a Redwood promo credit ledger entry and will expire on the listed date.
- We'll tag the usage with a partner_id=cloudcorp for observable attribution in Console billing and for reporting back to you monthly.
- For SOC/compliance reasons we'll need a redacted copy of your Marketplace T&Cs (SOC2 concern) — thanks for the SOC2_redacted.pdf.

Next steps (my proposed short runbook):
1) Redwood approves the voucher pool (internal approval).
2) CloudCorp confirms final CSV and expiry dates.
3) Redwood performs a small ingestion test (5 vouchers) and validates redemption flow.
4) We flip the pool live and provide your ops team a reporting link.

Rafael — can you confirm we can issue the 100 x $250 credits (total liability $25k) from the partner promo budget and that the tagging approach is okay? If you want a formal PO we can route that as well.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.coale@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOC2_redacted.pdf (redacted SOC2 summary)
From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for CloudCorp trial credit program

Marissa / Dev —

Reviewed. I'm fine approving the 100 vouchers at $250 each for the pilot (total exposure $25,000). Two notes:
1) Please record the partner_id tag for every redemption so Finance can reconcile marketplace-ledged liabilities vs direct Redwood promotions.
2) Require CloudCorp to sign a short partner promo agreement (one page) that confirms they won't transfer credits to third parties and accepts the redemption rules. A DocuSign link is fine.

Once Marissa sends me the final CSV and the agreement, I'll sign off and ask Billing to create the internal credits ledger entries.

-Rafael
Director, Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Patrick O'Neill <patrick.oneill@cloudcorp.com>, marketplace-ops@cloudcorp.com
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for CloudCorp trial credit program

Patrick —

Great — Rafael approved the pool. Attached is the blank one-page partner promo agreement and the ingestion checklist. Please:
- Confirm final CSV with expiry dates (reply to this thread).
- Sign the DocuSign link we've created: https://app.docusign.com/signer/?env=na1&token=ABCD1234EFGH

Once signed we'll ingest the list and run a 5-code test. Expected timeline: ingestion + test within 24 hours of signature; full pool go-live within 48 hours. We'll tag redemptions partner_id=cloudcorp and share a read-only Console reporting link.

Notes about limits: vouchers redeemable only on hosted.redwood.ai signups. If you want to support Dedicated later we can discuss a separate commercial route.

Thanks — looping marketplace-ops so they see the DocuSign link and checklist.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Partnerships | Redwood Inference
